title: A method for cluster federated learning based on model similarity
assignee: Chongqing University of Post and Telecommunications

pse.problem: Data heterogeneity in federated learning, particularly when dealing with non-IID data, leading to performance degradation in inference or classification
pse.solution_function: Cluster federated learning based on model similarity that addresses the influence of Non-IID and unbalanced data by implementing local training adjustment strategy and client clustering strategy
pse.solution_structure: Central server, multiple clients with local data, global model
pse.solution_implementation: Local training adjustment strategy: adaptively adjusts the number of local training epochs for each client. Client clustering strategy: clusters clients based on model similarity
pse.effect: Improves correctness and adaptability of clustering, leading to better performance in inference or classification
